shots.focal_element: Four collaborator cursors with name/role tags clustered left of the 'Go-To-Market Launch Plan' doc
shots.typography: Doc title in large bold sans-serif, title case, tight tracking; cursor tags use a bold name over a smaller regular-weight role line; doc body in small regular sans (font guess: Inter-like, low confidence).
shots.what_happens: A ClickUp doc window floats centred on a teal wave wallpaper under a grey dim overlay; four multiplayer cursors with name/role tags pop in on the left with small coloured sparkle bursts as the team 'loops in' (w30-w35), then hold still.
shots.build_rebuild: Render the doc window as a centred rounded card with drop shadow over a gradient wallpaper, add a 40% grey overlay, then pop in four cursor+tag groups staggered ~80 ms apart with a short radial particle burst on each.

shots.focal_element: The now-undimmed GTM Plan doc with the four collaborator cursors
shots.typography: Same as s006: bold title-case sans headline, bold name / regular role labels on cursor tags, small regular body text.
shots.what_happens: The grey overlay crossfades away, revealing the bright white doc and a lighter teal wallpaper; the cursors and tags stay in place while the voice asks if everybody is aligned (w36-w42).
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade the dim overlay opacity from ~0.4 to 0 over ~0.4 s while keeping the doc card and cursor tags static, brightening the wallpaper layer in the same tween.

shots.focal_element: The 'Department' dropdown with Wilson's cursor selecting 'Engineering', plus the 'Role-based Requests' label card
shots.transition_other: Scene swap to a new pink/purple wave wallpaper with the AI Tools panel blurring in to focus (detector reports 'other').
on_screen_text: Popular Design Email Engineering HR IT Marketing Product Project Sales Services SEO Social Success Support
shots.typography: UI menu items in regular sans, sentence case; 'DEPARTMENT' as small all-caps tracked-out overline; lower-left label card pairs a small bold all-caps tracked eyebrow ('USE CLICKUP AI FOR:') with a larger bold title-case headline ('Role-based Requests').
shots.what_happens: The AI Tools panel resolves from blur on a vivid wave wallpaper; Wilson's tagged cursor opens the department dropdown and picks Engineering (w49-w51), the list swaps to engineering prompts, the label card slides in lower-left, and the cursor picks 'Write technical specifications doc' (w52-w55), which opens the input form.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a centred menu card that de-blurs in, animate a labelled cursor along a path to open a dropdown and click 'Engineering', swap the list items in place, and slide a bordered lower-left caption card in from the left with an eyebrow + headline.

shots.focal_element: The 'Write technical specifications doc' form with fields filling in
shots.typography: Form labels in small regular sans, sentence case; field content in regular sans body size; 'Generate' in white on a filled accent button; caption card as in s008.
shots.what_happens: The form's three text fields fill with spec text (Business requirements, Systems involved, then Best practices typed on) while the voice says 'fill this out, and generate' (w56-w60); the lower-left label card fades out around 34.5 s.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centred form modal and type text into each field sequentially with a caret (Best practices visibly types character by character), then fade the caption card out over ~0.3 s.

shots.focal_element: The generated technical spec streaming inside the AI answer panel and the 'Insert' button
on_screen_text: Tell AI what to do next
shots.typography: Generated body copy in regular sans with bold section headings ('Business Requirements:', 'Conclusion:'); action row of small sentence-case buttons, 'Insert' white on filled accent.
shots.what_happens: On 'Whoa' (w61) the AI answer streams into the panel and scrolls quickly through sections to a Conclusion; Wilson's cursor (motion-blurred while moving) clicks Insert on 'Got it' (w62-w63), then the panel whips off with heavy motion blur.
shots.build_rebuild: Stream generated paragraphs into a fixed-height masked panel while auto-scrolling, move a labelled cursor with motion blur to click 'Insert', then exit the panel with a fast horizontal translate plus directional blur.
